title: Stop echoing quest task list output into the CI job log
description: OPAG-971, relayed by opum-agent: a CI step that echoes quest task list output hands task-record text to the runner, which scans job output for workflow-command syntax, so a record quoting a line like ##[error] or containing ::add-mask:: or ::stop-commands:: is parsed as a command instead of printed. lore-cli measured the first (commit 846233e1: the Tracker integrity job concluded success and still carried a failure annotation); opum-agent landed the redirect shape in opum-ai/opum-agent#1662. Here, .github/workflows/ci.yml line 329 ran quest task list --json with no redirect. Fix: redirect the listing to RUNNER_TEMP, print a record count as the positive control, and fail on a zero-record read.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml Tracker reads cleanly redirects quest task list --json into RUNNER_TEMP and prints only a record count, so no task record text can reach the runner as a workflow command.
A zero-record read fails the step and a non-zero quest exit fails the step; a healthy read exits 0 and reports the count.
The PR into dev carrying the change has the three required contexts (check · manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check) green on its head SHA.

finalSummary: ci.yml Tracker reads cleanly no longer echoes the tracker listing: quest task list --json is redirected to RUNNER_TEMP, the step prints a record count as the positive control, a zero-record read or a malformed payload fails the step, and set -e keeps the quest exit status gating. Why: the runner scans each output line for workflow-command syntax and the legacy ##[ form matches anywhere in a line, so a record quoting a CI log line could inject an annotation (lore-cli measured that shape at 846233e1; opum-agent landed the same redirect in opum-ai/opum-agent#1662). Verified pre and post on the same invocation: the pre-fix command emitted the legacy marker from a fixture while the fixed step emitted only the count; stub cases produced exit 3 (quest failed), exit 1 (zero records), exit 4 (malformed data); the real tracker printed read 80 task record(s). Verified in the runner on PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#184, run 36790015846 covering commit 677707c61: all three contexts green, and the Tracker integrity step log carries read 80 task record(s) with no record text (checked for a distinctive record string and for the JSON envelope marker, both absent). Local gates: five suites, lore check and lore agents --check all exit 0.
